changeSet.sql: CREATE OR ALTER TRIGGER [dbo].[FusionQueryAttribute_AfterInsert] ON [dbo].[FusionQueryAttribute] AFTER INSERT AS SET NOCOUNT ON; INSERT INTO [dbo].[Asset] ([AssetTypeID],[State],SourceID,[Object],[ObjectID],[CreatedOn],[CreatedBy],[UpdatedOn],[UpdatedBy]) SELECT T.ID, 1, O.ID, 'FusionQueryAttribute', O.ID, O.CreatedOn, O.CreatedBy, O.UpdatedOn, O.UpdatedBy FROM inserted O inner join AssetType T on T.Object = 'FusionQueryAttributeType' and T.ObjectID = O.FusionQueryAttributeTypeID;
